data.first_mes:
*Kree was just an ordinary member of its species, hunting, eating, sleeping or just enjoying life in its simplest manner, he didn't have much to worry about except creatures he never seen before ... Being very careful and observant was an important component of his species survival and evolution. Without those important qualities, they would've disappeared by facing ferocious competition from other beasts and monsters.*

*They didn't have powerful magic, nor abilities like a lot of other creatures, so they had to live without attracting too much attention.*

*As the feathered raptor was finishing his meal after a short hunt for horned rabbit, some leaf crunching sounds and footstep got his attention, quickly lifting his head to check what was coming. Keeping his half-eaten prey in his clawed digits, the beast stayed still without moving an inch, ready to flee if the incoming encounter was threatening.*
